_doc: c02: level offsets in dB for accompanying lines that sit under a melody at the same printed dynamic: [qn_start, qn_end, dB]. score_to_parts.py writes them into vol_db (track volume envelope, 0.5 qn ramps); timbre (CC11) is unchanged. c04: Vc countermelody cuts eased (B #3), Cb cuts with the EQ (B #2), Vln II bars 63-66 (B #4, C #5), Vla and Harp under the flute solo and the harp under the bar 53-56 violins (B #5), Vc at the bar 61 climax (B #1). c04 after the first render: Vln II bar 64 split [216,218,-8]/[218,220,-2] (beats 3-4 measured 9-13 dB under Vla/Vc), Vc [238,250,-3] (was 2 dB under Vln I), Flute 1 [262,270,-2] (3 dB over Vln I in bar 80). c05: first crescendo bars 57-60 (B #1: BCl, Vla, Cb, Hn1, Timp down, Vln I +2), second build-up (B #2: Cl1 -4, Vln I +2), bars 28-30 violas (B #3), final chord violas +4/+7 (B #4), timp bar 52 (B #5), Hn3/Hn4 muted close -4 (B #6). c06: a row may carry a fourth value end_ramp (qn): the cut opens linearly over the last end_ramp qn and is 0 at its end (C #1: Vc, BCl, Vla, Cb, Hn1 into the bar 61 ff). Cb soft cuts eased and the pizz. span +5 (B #1); Hn3 under the bar 79-81 tune, Hn1 bars 54-56 (B #5); Vln II/Vla under the bar 46-47 oboe (B #6); Tbn2/BTbn/Tuba +2 at the bar 61 climax (C #4); Cl1 [250,258] -4 -> -1 (B #2, the p soft trim does the rest). c07: Vc [250,274,-5] split into [250,262,-5]/[262,274,-1] and Cb [262,276,-2] removed (B #2, bass and tenor lines under the reeds at bars 79-81); Hn3 [261.5,271] -4 -> -1 (B #1, with the F4 pitch trim); Flute 2 [204,212,-3] (B #3); Cb and Bn2 [146,151,-3] under the bar 47 oboe (B #6). c08: Vc [238,250] -3 -> 0 (B #2), [250,262] -5 -> -3 (C #6), Vc [292,304,-4], Vln I [292,304,-3], Vla [289,304,-2] (C #4, coda); Vla [42,48,-3], [140,146,-4] under the oboe (B #6); Vln I [48,65,-3] for the solo with SOLO_BOOST off (C #5 interim).
